description: Compares real fundamental signals (P/E, real reference data) against a disclosed, real-price-derived momentum/volatility proxy for narrative intensity. Real fundamental/social sentiment data is not currently wired — narrative-side scoring is disclosed as a proxy, not literal sentiment measurement.

ticker.description: Stock ticker symbol (e.g. NVDA, TSLA, AAPL, MSFT)

name: analyze_narrative_divergence
returns: JSON object with divergence spread, reflexivity index, decouple category, and actionable hedge signal — all derived from real quote/reference data.
